def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd, glob
    paths = sorted(glob.glob('data/environment/input/water-body-testing-*.csv'))
    dfs = []
    for p in paths:
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df['__source_file'] = p
        dfs.append(df)
    out = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)
    return out

def process(water_all):
    import pandas as pd
    df = water_all.copy()
    # Normalize strings
    df['Beach Type Description'] = df['Beach Type Description'].astype(str).str.strip()
    df['Violation_norm'] = df['Violation'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    # Keep freshwater beaches only
    df = df[df['Beach Type Description'].str.lower().eq('fresh')]
    # Map violation to boolean; treat explicit yes/no; others -> NA
    df['is_exceedance'] = df['Violation_norm'].map({'yes': True, 'no': False})
    # Keep years 2002-2023 inclusive
    df = df[(df['Year'] >= 2002) & (df['Year'] <= 2023)]
    return df[['Year','Sample Date','Beach Name','Beach Type Description','Organism','Indicator Level','Violation','is_exceedance']]

def process(freshwater_beaches):
    import pandas as pd

    df = freshwater_beaches.copy()
    # exceedance rate per year = exceedance samples / total samples
    yearly = (
        df.groupby('Year')
          .agg(total_samples=('is_exceedance','size'),
               exceed_samples=('is_exceedance','sum'))
          .reset_index()
    )
    yearly['exceedance_rate'] = yearly['exceed_samples'] / yearly['total_samples']

    # overall average across years (simple mean of yearly rates)
    avg_rate = yearly['exceedance_rate'].mean()
    yearly['avg_exceedance_rate'] = avg_rate

    # compare using rounded-to-2-decimals rates as requested
    yearly['exceedance_rate_pct_2dp'] = (yearly['exceedance_rate'] * 100).round(2)
    yearly['avg_rate_pct_2dp'] = round(avg_rate * 100, 2)

    yearly['higher_than_avg_2dp'] = yearly['exceedance_rate_pct_2dp'] > yearly['avg_rate_pct_2dp']

    return yearly.sort_values('Year')
